title: Root-wise energy-intertwining input contract for the PAH-OMC-020 common-space passage
purpose: Specify the single dynamic datum missing between the R-525 static maximal-prefix coupling and the PAH-OMC-020 N2b form liminf. This contract tests an implication and does not define a new PAH dynamics or comparison map.

fixed_scope.functional_and_rates: Exactly PAH-001 F_rho and original PH/LK/AP/TR rates through the pinned OMC-018 chain; no refit, counterterm, averaging or rate change.
fixed_scope.state: Original labelled finite Gibbs laws and the R-510 compatible limiting state; no phasewise or cross-Q direct sum.
fixed_scope.comparison: Use the R-525 maximal-prefix conditional-expectation candidate only as a static map. It is not promoted to a source-authorized owner packet.
fixed_scope.forms: E_n and E_infty are the unchanged reversible Dirichlet forms with the directed-half convention; E_infty is represented by the R-512 minimal closed form at its pinned scope.
fixed_scope.order: The preregistered j->infinity passage at fixed n precedes the anchored n comparison.
fixed_scope.time: External unaccelerated Markov time only; no quantum, proper or Lorentzian interpretation.

required_dynamic_datum.root_index: A correspondence of every finite directed root with its limiting root(s), including multiplicity and partial-domain indicators.
required_dynamic_datum.difference_intertwining: For every local f and root r, a declared defect d_(n,r)(f)=Delta_(infty,r)(U_n f)-K_(n,r)U_n(Delta_(n,r)f) with an explicit norm bound, or an exact root-wise dynamic coupling that defines it.
required_dynamic_datum.conductance_control: The target/source conductance weights and the contraction factor K_(n,r) must satisfy the weighted square inequality before summing roots.
required_dynamic_datum.uniformity: The defect and conductance bounds must be uniform in the anchored n exhaustion on the declared form domain; local N1 recovery alone is not enough.
required_dynamic_datum.terminal_boundary: The unsplit finite terminal square and the R-510 split-cell boundary must be covered by the same root correspondence, without conditional averaging or an unpinned density multiplier.

conditional_implication.single_root: If w_infty,r*kappa_(n,r)^2 <= w_n,r and Delta_infty,r(U_n f)=kappa_(n,r)Delta_n,r(f), then the target root contribution is no larger than the source root contribution.
conditional_implication.sum: If the root-wise conditions hold for all directed roots and the residual is summable with a uniform bound, then E_infty(U_n f) <= E_n(f)+defect_n(f), with defect_n(f)->0 yielding the N2b recovery-side estimate.
conditional_implication.status: Implication only; no PAH-specific kappa, root coupling, conductance comparison or uniform defect is supplied by R-525/R-528.

diagnostic_witness.description: A two-state reversible oracle with identical stationary marginals and identity static coupling has L2 contraction but target Dirichlet energy larger than source when its target rate is doubled.
diagnostic_witness.scope: Abstract insufficiency witness only; not a PAH carrier, not a PAH counterexample and not an infinite-volume statement.

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only if a source-authorized root-wise dynamic intertwining or uniform form-defect packet is hash-pinned and all verification roles agree.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only if the unchanged PAH definitions themselves yield an exact form-compatibility contradiction; the abstract diagnostic witness is not sufficient.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Use when only static coupling contraction is available and the required root-wise dynamic datum or uniform defect is absent.

single_next_question: Can a source owner provide a versioned root-wise conductance-compatible dynamic intertwining (including the terminal-square correspondence) for the exact R-525 U_n, or a uniform vanishing form defect, without changing PAH-001?
revisit_condition: Reopen after a source-authorized packet with root multiplicity, dynamic defect, conductance weights, uniform n bound and terminal-boundary treatment is supplied; otherwise do not repeat static coupling fixtures.
non_claims: No source-authorized U_n, N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape, N2d minimal-form identification or PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence.
The two-state witness is not a PAH counterexample and does not prove a universal impossibility theorem.
No change to PAH-001 functional, rates, state, carrier, regulator, time or limit order.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
